text.p: Swedish engineer Sandvik was
expected to post a profit after financial items of 4.65 billion
crowns for 1996, according to a Reuters poll of 13 analysts.
This compared to a profit of 5.62 billion in 1995.
Forecasts for 1996 varied between 4.45 billion crowns to
4.83 billion crowns.
Analysts on average forecast a profit after financial items
of 5.06 billion crowns in 1998.
They forecast a dividend for 1996 of six crowns a share.
Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aros, Carnegie,
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Enskilda, Fiba Nordic, Fischer
Partners, Goldman Sachs, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Kleinwort
Benson, Matteus, Morgan Stanley, and Swedbank.
The result is due around 1300 local, 1200 GMT, on Monday.
